name: lab1-hello-world
description: Minimal JavaScript Hello World project with Jest tests and CI

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const out='build/hello.js'; fs.mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true}); const src=fs.readFileSync('src/index.js','utf8'); fs.writeFileSync(out, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' + src);"
